_comment: chunk inner-loop validation, wired through a cross-platform launcher (scripts/chunk/agent-hook.mjs) so the gates run via WSL on Windows and natively on macOS/Linux, and degrade to a no-op when chunk isn't installed. permissions.allow is scoped to the read-only `chunk validate` the gates use; state-mutating chunk commands (sidecar/task/snapshot) still prompt. See docs/guides/chunk-sidecars.md.
